correctness.rationale: Reconstructed Pappus graph from nine affine points and nine affine lines (18 vertices,27 edges), all 2598 independent sets including empty, and all 216 affine/duality automorphisms; independently summed signed setwise-fixed oriented faces to obtain trace distribution {-2:21,-1:72,0:54,1:32,2:36,10:1}. The source mod-two boundary rank calculation gives rational homology bounded by Betti_4=10; Euler characteristic forces rational rank exactly ten, all in degree 4. Normal C3 vertical translation z has trace 1 on z,z^2, so idempotent (1+z+z^2)/3 gives ranks 4 and 6. Both nonzero orthogonal constituent character norms are 1 (independently checked), proving complex absolute irreducibility.
